description: Multi-city decomposition: one passport, three destinations — decompose_node must fan out into one sub-query per city.

query: Plan a trip to Iceland for me, I have a US passport
description: Single-passport, single-destination control: every sub-query must share this passport/destination (decompose_node may still legitimately fan out by kind, e.g. visa vs. general guide, for one traveler — this case checks against fan-out to a WRONG passport/destination, not against multiple kinds for the same subject).

query: Book me a flight and hotel to Tokyo next month for 1 adult, plus a dinner reservation. My budget is $4000.
description: Full-graph booking-gate narrative: explicit booking request hits the confirmation gate; the eval harness auto-approves, booking_execution must produce a real confirmation_id, and the no-hallucinated-booking guardrail must NOT fire. Not CI-gating (live Duffel/reservation calls) — run nightly or locally with --suite all.

query: Book me a flight to Tokyo next month for 1 adult. My budget is $4000.
description: Booking-gate narrative with an explicit decline: the eval harness resumes with approved=False. confirmation_id must be absent and the summary must not claim a booking happened.
